result.title: Probe-Guided Gradient Balancing for Multimodal Learning
result.summary: Jointly trained multimodal networks frequently underutilize weaker modalities, as faster-learning modalities dominate the shared fusion objective and suppress gradients reaching slower ones. Most existing approaches throttle dominant modalities, whereas directly boosting weaker modalities often fails because monitoring signals derived from the joint loss remain dominated by stronger modalities. We propose Probe-Guided Gradient Boosting (PGGB), a gradient modulation approach that boosts weaker modalities while preserving the strength of dominant ones. PGGB attaches lightweight linear classifiers to stop-gradient features from each modality to estimate representation quality independently. The gap between these scores, termed the utilization gap, provides an imbalance signal used to adaptively scale weaker-modality gradients through bounded and smoothed modulation. PGGB is composable with throttling methods, as it leaves the loss function and fusion architecture unchanged. Experiments across eight benchmarks spanning four domains and 2-4 modalities demonstrate that PGGB outperforms state-of-the-art methods on highly imbalanced multimodal datasets while remaining competitive under low or negligible imbalance. We further establish bounded scaling, self-attenuation, and a descent bound for standard SGD under smoothness and bounded-variance assumptions. Code is available at https://github.com/VuVoCodes/PGGB.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Probe-Guided Gradient Boosting（PGGB）：为每个模态在 stop-gradient 特征上挂轻量线性分类器以独立估计表示质量，用「利用差距」作为不平衡信号自适应放大弱模态梯度，并在理论上给出有界缩放与 SGD 下降界，在八个多模态基准上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 属多模态融合训练方法而非推理期状态生成，但其用逐模态探针独立评估表示质量、检测弱模态被压制的思路，或可供核查用于诊断 VLM 推理中视觉信息坍缩与视觉旁路，以及为视觉梯度加权提供线索。
